police3.synopsis: An honest citizen saw a man dump a gun behind the Eagle Building, and Deeks knows where. Darci finds him in the park; he points her to the skips in the centre of town. Once she has the weapon, its armed owner comes looking for it, and she must arrest or drop him before taking the gun back to the station. Meanwhile the city is uneasy: a drunk tramp warns of 'dark things on the horizon', people gossip that there's 'something of the night about that Bane character', and a cop says one Wildcat set was caught with a vanload of AK-47s. A disturbance at the diner, where men call the customers SINNERS, gives two more suspects. Killing or arresting Deeks fails it.
characters: **Two diner suspects**: Wildcats calling people sinners (guilty)
A drunk tramp, a man who has to 'eat ALL the pigeons', a man with a balloon, a gossiping cop, Bane-wary citizens

Gangorder2.synopsis: Mako again. A Wildcat contact tells him to collect McLean and Bish and get the job from Spiv: the Boss wants the son of McIntyre, a friend of the cops, brought in unharmed. The son bolts. Run him down to half health and he surrenders and follows Mako to the drop. Kill him and the Boss's punishment is five more dead cops, which Mako relishes. The district crawls with police, and losing Spiv, Bish, McLean or the escort ends the job.
characters: **Spiv**: Wildcat fixer who passes on the Boss's orders
**Bish** and **McLean**: Wildcat muscle, McLean recruited at gunpoint
**The Wildcat contact** who meets Mako, and a hanger-on who thought Mako would be bigger

police4.synopsis: Gang-bangers are loitering in Bushy Park and the residents, and reporter Gordansky, are complaining. Darci clears the Wildcats out; the punks talk about 'sinners', 'the fallen', and a CHANGE coming, and two of them arrange a meet at the Ballpark 'tonight'. A mystery man who knew her father introduces himself as Roper and tells her what's going on: Mack Banes, the mayoral candidate, has taken the Wildcats under his wing, and three of their leaders meet tonight at the UC Baseball park. Bring one in and he'll talk. Roper must survive.
characters: **Mack Banes** (mentioned): mayoral candidate backing the Wildcats
Wildcats arranging the meet at the Ballpark
Two friends fighting over a forgotten ball, a loiterer, residents talking about 'wolves among us'

bball2.synopsis: A tip-off: three gang leaders meet at the UC 'Black Cats' stadium to carve up their turf after the Bushy Park troubles. Georgie, on the gate, says only Wild Bill can let her in. Bill was the baseball team's manager until the Wildcats pushed him out last month, and he's found drinking at Posheeta's Mexican Diner after a detour through a nightclub full of drunks and dancers. Through the back alley Darci gets into the grounds, where Wildcats hold workmen hostage and talk of Banes and AK-47s, and armed men are pinned in a corner by cops. She has to bring a gang boss in alive. Killing the last one ruins the info for Roper.
characters: **Wild Bill**: former 'Black Cats' manager, now a barfly
**Georgie**: stadium gateman, one of Bill's boys
Wildcat guards, hostage workmen, a tramp defending his yard, cops in a standoff, club-goers

wstores1.synopsis: The Wildcats keep two arms caches in Darci's sector, and she has to handle it alone before Gordansky and UCNN broadcast the force's failure. Roper calls her to Geebag Street for equipment: the Wildcats 'are more than you think'. She sabotages the stores around Reagan Plaza and the Rio Canal Boathouse and wipes out the pick-up team before their van collects. Overheard: Wildcats have 'plans' for Gordansky via their Southside crew; a Wildcat guard, Spinks, frets that only 'our Man' knows the plan; and two cops say orders from on high mean working with the Wildcats now. Side jobs: haul in 'Bloody' Mary Schwartz from the bar, stop a citizen assault.
characters: **'Bloody' Mary Schwartz**: wanted, at the bar
**Spinks** and another Wildcat guard: doubts about 'our Man'
The pick-up team, working girls, a flasher, a cabbie, a man searching for alien life ('WIBBLE')

e3.synopsis: Gordansky snooped too close and the Wildcats have her trussed up in a beach house at the edge of Southside. UCNN will crucify the force if she dies. Roper hands Darci equipment and leaves on 'other matters'. She fights through Southside's Wildcats, who now call outsiders SINNERS and threaten to kill on sight, takes out the lookout and the reporter's guard, and frees her. Gordansky, grateful despite her TV attacks on the UCPD, tells Darci the Wildcats are backed by someone big in City Hall. Along the way: Shard leans on Finkel, who builds the car bomb timers; a man is on the edge of suicide; Mr Shaw is extorted for files; drug dealer Ed Miller runs. Killing the hostage, Roper or the Chief fails it.
characters: **The Chief**: on the scene; mustn't be hurt
A man ready to die, a mugging victim, a cop with a car key, Wildcat lookouts

westcrime1.synopsis: The gang boss from the stadium squealed under O'Byrne and Kowalski: the Wildcats are massing an army to take West District. The station is attacked and Darci has three minutes to break every wave of Wildcats, Man In Black fighters among them, before the district falls. Officer Schwartz insists on coming along and must be kept alive.
characters: Waves of Wildcats and Man In Black fighters

carbomb1.synopsis: 'Terrorists' have planted a car bomb outside the bank in Gangland and the gangs have sealed the area so the bomb squad can't get in. Darci fights her way in and drives the sedan back to the disposal team before its 90 seconds run out, then a second one outside Harbours department store. She recognizes the bombers. They're Wildcat specialists brought in from out of town, not terrorists in disguise as the Sarge believes, and she arrests both in the park. Searching their den by the derelict buildings turns up a UCNN video tape, which she links to Gordansky's kidnapping. Hurting the bomb engineers or killing the bombers fails it.
characters: **The Sarge**: thinks the bombers are terrorists dressed as Wildcats
Bystanders with theories: aliens, government tests, Bane 'like an old, ugly bulldog'

botanicc.synopsis: Sergeant Bryant spent two months on a drugs ring until someone inside the force tipped off the dealers, who stashed $3 million of narcotics in the closed Botanical Gardens. Darci gets in (the power, the lifts and the high-pressure jets are on switches), finds explosives, and blows both narcotics stores. Gordansky is there following her own trail: the car bombing wasn't a one-off, the Southside Wildcats are dealing for half a ton of explosives. Other threads: a Wildcat's mother scolding her son ('your daddy was a respectable MUGGER'), the parole-breaker Koots, a dealer selling 'close-to-home-made' product, a gunman who shot a cop outside the hotel. The gardens have plaques: 'Twinned with the town of GUILDFORD'. Arresting or killing Gordansky gets Darci suspended.
characters: **A dealer** and his customer with a balloon
An eight-year veteran cop, a frustrated plumber, gossiping locals

Semtex.synopsis: Southside again: rumours say the Wildcats will take over this patch, and Deeks wants to pass Darci 'personal info'. Wildcats attack them at the gas station. Deeks says a man in City Hall pulls the strings and sends her to Officer Molko on 11th Street, then goes to ground; one of the attackers came for 'Deeks you RAT'. Molko sends her to 'a friend of both of ours': Roper, who says the Wildcats mean to rid the city of the UCPD altogether, and gives her a shotgun if she's with him. Along the way she saves a man being thrown off a roof for not 'paying dues' and confronts Sergeant Smyth, the cop who has been tipping off the Wildcats. Roper sends her to the docks: two barrels of Semtex that Bane is counting on to 'save his election campaign'. One shot each sets them off.
characters: **Sergeant Smyth**: rogue cop working with the Wildcats
**Southside Wildcats** led by a pair who know Darci by name, with 'Spider'
A man being thrown off a roof, a Wildcat with a grenade guarding the Semtex
